issues.title: Add Coach↔Athlete authorization end to end
issues.outcome: An Authentik-authenticated Coach can work only with explicitly assigned athletes, while Athlete self-service continues unchanged and every cross-athlete action is auditable.
behavior: Represent application principal role separately from athlete identity.
Persist active/inactive Coach↔Athlete assignments with history.
Resolve actor and target athlete on every athlete-scoped route.
Return 403 for an unassigned Coach without leaking unnecessary athlete existence information.
Audit Coach actor, target athlete, action and entity.
Expose explicit current-athlete context in Coach-facing UI paths without redesigning the accepted layout.
domainInvariants: Authentik trusted-proxy authentication remains mandatory in production.
Athlete access to own data remains backward compatible.
No Coach has implicit global athlete access.
Athlete-authored subjective observations cannot be rewritten through Coach privilege.
assumptions: Coach↔Athlete assignment administration may initially be operator-controlled.
securityAndMigration: Add authorization regression tests to all representative athlete-scoped route families.
tests: Athlete A cannot access Athlete B.
Coach assigned to A can access A.
Audit record identifies Coach actor and athlete target.
acceptanceEvidence: Manual/API smoke with two athletes + one Coach demonstrates allowed and denied paths.
nonGoals: Organization/team hierarchy beyond explicit Coach↔Athlete assignment.

issues.title: Import canonical Skillz training plans with revision history
issues.outcome: An Athlete or assigned Coach can import a canonical Skillz plan bundle, re-import identical content idempotently, and retain explicit history for changed plans.
behavior: Accept sport-training-plan.json plus transport-only referenced companion artifacts.
Validate contract version/shape before persistence.
Store producer/source refs and content hash.
Map canonical season/meso/micro/session data into existing planning persistence without redefining sport-science semantics.
Preserve session IDs, objectives, duration, planned RPE, intensity/stop rules, flexibility and structured items.
Treat same hash as idempotent success; changed content creates explicit revision.
domainInvariants: Skillz owns sport-science semantics.
No silent overwrite of historical plan state.
Transport envelope cannot reinterpret canonical artifacts.
assumptions: Exact import-envelope name/endpoint is implementation detail.
securityAndMigration: Only Athlete self or assigned Coach may import for target athlete.
tests: Same bundle twice creates no duplicate revision.
Changed bundle creates revision and retains prior version.
acceptanceEvidence: UI/API import demo showing current + prior revision.

issues.title: Unify FIT/manual journal completion with plan-vs-actual views
issues.outcome: An Athlete can finalize a real session once—whether manual or FIT-backed—with RPE and subjective context, and Athlete/assigned Coach can inspect transparent session/week Soll-Ist.
behavior: Preserve existing Garmin FIT/TCX, Concept2 and RP3 normalization/dedupe.
Link an activity to a compatible planned session without auto-finalizing subjective data.
Require Session-RPE to finalize.
Capture easier/as_expected/harder, optional pain, structured deviations and optional Athlete comment.
Preserve Athlete authorship and separate Coach notes.
Converge manual and imported paths onto exactly one completed_session; late imports attach instead of duplicating.
Show session and weekly plan-vs-actual duration/RPE and available intensity/items/distance/work plus provenance.
domainInvariants: One real session→one canonical activity and one completed-session record.
Provider evidence is immutable/provenanced.
Morning Check remains distinct; passive data never replaces pain/illness/subjective reporting.
No opaque compliance score.
assumptions: Exact structured deviation taxonomy may be extended without changing confirmed minimum semantics.
securityAndMigration: Coach cannot overwrite Athlete subjective fields.
Existing FIT/C2/RP3 dedupe behavior must regress-test cleanly.
tests: FIT-linked session finalizes only after RPE.
Manual completion then late FIT import does not duplicate.
Weekly Soll-Ist renders available metrics without black-box score.
acceptanceEvidence: Regression tests for provider dedupe + completion convergence.
nonGoals: Mandatory extra fatigue/motivation scales after every session.

issues.title: Add structured RowErg and bike performance testing
issues.outcome: Athlete or assigned Coach can plan, execute and review fixed RowErg and staged lactate tests while measured, derived and estimated values remain distinguishable.
behavior: Support test lifecycle from planned protocol through performed result and retest history.
Provide fixed RowErg protocols: 500m, 1k, 2k, 5k, 30min.
Provide RowErg and bike lactate step tests.
Provide configurable staged protocol.
Persist stage duration, power/pace, HR, lactate, RPE, cadence/stroke rate and comment.
Persist device, protocol/version, warm-up, environment, termination reason, actor/time and notes.
Classify relevant values as measured, derived or assumed_or_estimated.
Keep interpretation/recommendation ownership in Skillz.
domainInvariants: Assumptions are never presented/exported as measurements.
App stores evidence; it does not invent thresholds from incomplete tests.
assumptions: Protocol presentation may reuse existing card/form grammar.
securityAndMigration: Coach test operations require active assignment.
tests: Save/reload RowErg and bike staged lactate test.
Generic staged protocol accepts configurable stages.
acceptanceEvidence: Browser demo for fixed and staged tests.

issues.title: Export deterministic adaptation handoff and apply validated proposals explicitly
issues.outcome: Athlete or assigned Coach can download an inspectable minimized adaptation JSON, import a validated proposal, and explicitly apply it once without any model directly mutating the plan.
behavior: Build a deterministic versioned sport-athlete-adaptation-handoff from profile/goals/current plan/Soll-Ist/completions/subjective observations/check-ins/tests/notes/safety/uncertainties/source refs.
Let user inspect/download the JSON before external use.
Exclude unrelated raw telemetry and secrets.
Accept only schema-valid returned proposal artifacts; invalid output fails closed.
Importing proposal never mutates plan.
Explicit authenticated Athlete or assigned-Coach apply records actor and prior/new versions and is single-application safe.
Define contract-only future Athlete-learning promotion boundary with evidence refs, conditions, counter-evidence, confidence and freshness.
Do not implement automatic Second-Brain writes.
domainInvariants: MVP has no LLM dependency.
Model/service output is proposal-only.
Authorization/safety gates are deterministic.
No raw operational telemetry is promoted to Second Brain.
assumptions: Embedded provider configuration remains a later issue; manual download/upload is canonical v1 path.
securityAndMigration: No API keys/secrets in exported JSON.
Proposal/apply events are audited and version-bound.
tests: Export is deterministic for same snapshot.
Valid proposal import alone leaves plan unchanged.
Explicit apply changes supported version exactly once.
acceptanceEvidence: End-to-end manual export→proposal import→explicit apply demo.

issues.title: Provide athlete data export and privacy rollout gate
issues.outcome: Athletes can self-export their longitudinal data, assigned Coaches are authorization-bound, and the product has a verifiable retention/deletion/logging gate before broad multi-user rollout.
behavior: Provide authenticated Athlete self-service structured export covering profile/goals, plan/revisions, journal/completions, activity/source summaries, check-ins, tests, adaptation history and relevant audit records.
State whether raw provider files are included or only referenced.
Permit assigned Coach export only through explicit authorization/audit.
Document and verify retention policy, deletion/request procedure, immutable audit/security treatment and backup/restore-window handling.
Review application/proxy logging so journal/symptom/test/physiology payloads are not emitted unnecessarily.
domainInvariants: Export never broadens authorization.
Operational/audit evidence treatment is explicit rather than silently deleted.
Privacy-sensitive payloads are minimized in logs.
assumptions: Provider raw-file inclusion may be reference-only where size/privacy makes bundling inappropriate, but manifest must be explicit.
securityAndMigration: Deletion/retention procedure must account for backups and immutable security evidence.
tests: Export manifest identifies included/excluded provider raw files.
Logging test/review confirms sensitive bodies are not emitted by default.
acceptanceEvidence: Documented retention/deletion/backup procedure with verification checklist.
nonGoals: Automated account deletion UI if operator procedure satisfies the v1 rollout gate.

issues.title: Deploy Rowing Sport OS v1 behind Authentik on Hetzner
issues.outcome: The approved v1 runs at sportjournal.ratzeburg-ai.de through Authentik with private PostgreSQL and passes the complete Athlete/Coach/FIT/plan/test/export/adaptation production smoke suite.
behavior: Deploy repository Dockerfile through Coolify with PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://sportjournal.ratzeburg-ai.de.
Use private PostgreSQL 18.x and least-privilege credentials.
Keep Authentik trusted proxy/header secret boundary and eliminate public bypass routes.
Run checksum-tracked forward migrations and readiness.
Execute representative Athlete and Coach smoke paths plus plan/FIT/test/export/adaptation checks.
Verify backup/restore appropriate to deployment stage.
domainInvariants: PostgreSQL 5432 is not public.
Production AUTH_MODE remains proxy.
No second unauthenticated app route.
Failed reasoning cannot mutate training plan.
assumptions: DNS target may be changed later without changing product data model.
securityAndMigration: Production secrets remain in Coolify/secret store.
Backup/restore verification precedes meaningful athlete-data rollout.
tests: npm run migrate + npm run ready green.
Proposal import cannot mutate until explicit apply.
acceptanceEvidence: Recorded deployment checklist and smoke evidence.
Verified public Authentik route and private DB/bypass posture.
